name: cloudplus-ui-workspace
description: Cloudplus UI — монорепо: библиотека (packages/ui), витрина компонентов (apps/preview), дизайн-макеты CRM (apps/design-lab)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w apps/preview && npm run build -w apps/design-lab
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/ui && npm run typecheck -w apps/preview && npm run typecheck -w apps/design-lab
